prompt:
❤️ J-RED Loop 119 — MEDIUM: extend the existing LOCAL-FAKE ACP text-update primitive from exactly 1 to bounded 1..3 official agent_message_chunk notifications, then exactly 1 terminal response.

Goal:
The adopted acp_mock_text_update_wire() now handles only one text chunk. Real ACP responses commonly send multiple chunks. Reuse the current strict JSON-RPC validation helper, one existing stdio process and the official ACP protocol shape. Extend only this narrow existing mock function to concatenate 1..3 text chunks deterministically before the terminal session/prompt response. No real provider/model/API and no generic streaming client.

Read first:
- current src/relay/acp_client.py::_acp_handshake, _acp_exchange, _acp_read_terminal_response, acp_mock_prompt_wire, acp_mock_text_update_wire.
- current tests/relay/test_acp_client.py::TestACPMockTextUpdateWire and existing initialize/session/prompt test classes.
- pinned agentclientprotocol/python-sdk commit 9d07d7871ef4b220b8507e15fc4b1560f0950a64 src/acp/meta.py and src/acp/schema.py: CLIENT_METHODS["session_update"]="session/update"; SessionNotification params sessionId and update; agent_message_chunk content type text; official PromptResponse stopReason literals.
- current src/relay/acp_stdio_transport.py READ ONLY.

Allowed changed paths ONLY:
- src/relay/acp_client.py
- tests/relay/test_acp_client.py

Concrete implementation:
1. Preserve acp_mock_text_update_wire(command,*args,cwd:str,prompt_text:str,timeout:float=2.0) -> dict[str,str], including one child process, single initialize id=0 and session/new id=1 handshake and exactly one session/prompt request id=2. Return shape is still {"text": concatenated_text, "stopReason": valid_official_literal}.
2. Read bounded inbound frames after sending prompt: 1, 2 or 3 JSON-RPC 2.0 id-absent notifications, each method="session/update", params.sessionId EXACT current session, update.sessionUpdate="agent_message_chunk", content={"type":"text","text":str}; concatenate text in arrival order with no inserted separators. Require a valid terminal reply id=2, result.stopReason one of pinned official literals, after 1..3 notifications. Use existing terminal validation; do NOT falsely accept an early terminal before any chunk.
3. HARD CAP: at most THREE text updates and one terminal response. A fourth update before terminal must fail closed; terminal EOF, timeout, wrong/bool id, result missing, RPC error, malformed JSON/object, wrong session, unsupported update type, invalid/missing text, notification containing an id, interleaved extra frames before terminal, missing/invalid stopReason must also fail closed. Use a strict fixed small frame loop (at most 4 readlines) or equally simple bounded implementation. No unbounded stream, queue or worker.
4. Preserve existing acp_initialize_wire(), acp_open_session_wire(), acp_mock_prompt_wire() behavior and previous single-chunk test. If a shared private parsing function removes duplicated code and is strictly tiny, use it; otherwise do not refactor unrelated helpers.
5. Keep this primitive explicitly named MOCK; do not wire it directly into a live provider or claim live readiness. No new constructor arguments or generic router.

Tests:
- All existing TestACPMockTextUpdateWire cases remain PASS, including exact handshake request assertions and the four negative notification subtests from Controller review.
- Add focused 2-chunk and 3-chunk positive local fake scripts asserting exact concatenation and stopReason, while using the SAME child process and exact request IDs 0,1,2. Keep single-chunk positive unchanged.
- Add missing-chunk early terminal, fourth update, and additional malformed/mismatched subsequent chunk fail-closed cases. Include at least one case where the first chunk was valid but a later chunk was malformed; never return partial success.
- Cover timeout/EOF before terminal and invalid stopReason. Do not create subprocess leaks; fake child must read #2 prompt before sending notifications.
- Full repository suite and compile pass. No real provider invocation.

Do Not Touch:
- no new dependencies/files, generalized RPC router, streaming framework, status/provenance layer, new queue, retry, fallback or automatic permission.
- no src/relay/bridge.py, core_adapter.py, provider profile/factory/policy, transport, dispatcher, lifecycle, Claude Gate, main, workflows, carrier, documentation or other lanes.
- no npm/npx/install, network, billing, auth, live model/provider/API/Jules extra launches; no Merge, force push, rebase, branch deletion or default-branch write.
- retry=0; fallback=disabled.
